entries.IRONCLAD.aromaPrinciple: [sine][red]Pain is nothing. My enemies must die.[/red][/sine]
entries.IRONCLAD.cardsModifierDescription: Ironclad cards will now appear in rewards and shops.
entries.IRONCLAD.description:
The last soldier of the Ironclads.
Crushes foes with sword and flame against his will.
entries.IRONCLAD.goldMonologue: [sine]These riches can bolster my tribe's armory...[/sine]
entries.IRONCLAD.title: The Ironclad

entries.IRONCLAD2_EPOCH.description:
[red]The Ironclad.[/red] A warrior from a faraway land entered the [gold]Spire[/gold].
Driven by pure instinct and accursed blood, he has lost all reason and identity.

All who prevent his ascent shall perish.
entries.IRONCLAD2_EPOCH.title: The Ironclad
entries.IRONCLAD2_EPOCH.unlockInfo: Beat [gold]Act[/gold] [blue]1[/blue] with the [red]Ironclad[/red]{IsRevealed:| to reveal this Epoch}.
entries.IRONCLAD3_EPOCH.description:
[jitter]The [red]Ironclad’s[/red] strength surges![/jitter]

The flames of the Demonic pact course through his blood. Cuts and bruises heal rapidly. The [blue]Valleyguard[/blue] are cleaved in two, the [orange]Desert Tribe[/orange] are burned to a crisp, [green]Wind Walkers[/green] [jitter]smashed[/jitter] into the ground, and even a familiar horde of aggressive bronze-cladded warriors are set ablaze with these [sine]exciting new flames[/sine]!

All of the Ironclad’s enemies are shown no mercy. All of the Ironclads... Ironclad?
...where is everyone?
entries.IRONCLAD3_EPOCH.title: Devastation
entries.IRONCLAD3_EPOCH.unlockInfo: Beat [gold]Act[/gold] [blue]2[/blue] with the [red]Ironclad[/red]{IsRevealed:| to reveal this Epoch}.
entries.IRONCLAD4_EPOCH.description: For centuries, war raged between the [red]Ironclads[/red] and the [blue]Valleyguard[/blue]. Driven by ambition, a young ironclad ventures to the forbidden boundary and bargains with the sacred [jitter]“Demon”[/jitter].
entries.IRONCLAD4_EPOCH.title: The Pact
entries.IRONCLAD4_EPOCH.unlock:
The [red]Ironclad's[/red] rage cannot be tamed...
[red]Ascension[/red] difficulties can be activated when starting a run.
entries.IRONCLAD4_EPOCH.unlockInfo: Beat [gold]Act[/gold] [blue]3[/blue] with the [red]Ironclad[/red]{IsRevealed:| to reveal this Epoch}.
entries.IRONCLAD5_EPOCH.description:
The [red]Ironclad[/red] slays the [purple]Heart[/purple] with its full might... and the Demon's Contract hungrily absorbs the [purple]Blight[/purple] unto itself.

Immediately, the warrior and [purple]Blight[/purple] are set ablaze. The parasite is drawn into the flame, its writhing form consumed like wax wicking into a fire.
entries.IRONCLAD5_EPOCH.title: Ablaze
entries.IRONCLAD5_EPOCH.unlockInfo: {IsRevealed:Killed|Kill} [blue]15[/blue] [purple]Elites[/purple] with the [red]Ironclad[/red]{IsRevealed:| to reveal this Epoch}.
entries.IRONCLAD6_EPOCH.description:
It is said that a never ceasing flame atop the [gold]Spire[/gold] burns proudly. Proven by the neighboring clouds glowing a gentle violet through the darkest winter nights.

Then one day, the clouds were normal.
The [purple]flame[/purple] went out.
entries.IRONCLAD6_EPOCH.title: Snuffed
entries.IRONCLAD6_EPOCH.unlockInfo: {IsRevealed:Killed|Kill} [blue]15[/blue] [red]Bosses[/red] with the [red]Ironclad[/red]{IsRevealed:| to reveal this Epoch}.
entries.IRONCLAD7_EPOCH.description:
“The [gold]Spire[/gold] was mine to rule. But the Architect lives again. [jitter]Look what he's done to my FACE[/jitter].”

The Demon throws a massive fit, smashing his chamber and setting all manner of things on fire.

“My death puppet, brandish my power and kill again. [jitter]KILL THE ARCHITECT!![/jitter]”
entries.IRONCLAD7_EPOCH.title: My Face
entries.IRONCLAD7_EPOCH.unlockInfo: Beat [red]Ascension[/red] [blue]1[/blue] with the [red]Ironclad[/red]{IsRevealed:| to reveal this Epoch}.
